native_edges.claim: Track+280 returns its containing node. Recursive context construction gets the first associated event from node+58 list, compares it to node+30 owner, creates the root case or recurses through the parent container, then binds the explicit node if needed. This is a concrete counted/owned graph path, not nearest-name ancestry.

Root context begins canonical with zero ranges. Copies retain parent state, then bind child event/node datum and recompute child origin from parent+108. Context+78 is a datum-bound origin, not a raw event offset. Direct positive-zero ancestor inputs make the admitted origin zero.

Start uses containing datum, whereas scalar Length/Offset use audio-track-selected own clip datum. Datum0 to canonical1 calls clock+30 then divides1; datum10 multiplies its scalar then divides1. Offset negation/zero behavior is explicit.
